knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

R can act as a calculator directly from the console — every operator below
can be typed and evaluated on the spot.

# Arithmetic Operators

### Addition: `+`
```{r}
1 + 1
```

### Subtraction: `-`
```{r}
1 - 1
```

### Multiplication: `*`
```{r}
1 * 1
```

### Division: `/`
```{r}
1 / 1
```

### Modulus (remainder of a division): `%%`
```{r}
1 %% 2
```

### Exponent: `^` or `**`
```{r}
2 ^ 10 # or 2 ** 10
```

### Integer division: `%/%`
```{r}
1035 %/% 3
```

# Logical Operators

### Less than: `<`
```{r}
1 < 1
```

### Less than or equal to: `<=`
```{r}
1 <= 1
```

### Greater than: `>`
```{r}
1 > 1
```

### Greater than or equal to: `>=`
```{r}
1 >= 1
```

### Exactly equal to: `==`
```{r}
"R" == "r"
```

R is case-sensitive — `"R"` and `"r"` are different values.

The equality operator can also compare one element against several at once:
```{r}
"Species" == c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", "Petal.Length", "Petal.Width", "Species")
```

### Not equal to: `!=`
```{r}
1 != 1
```

### Negation / NOT: `!`
Flips `TRUE` to `FALSE` and vice versa.
```{r}
!TRUE  # or !T
!FALSE # or !F

!(TRUE & FALSE) # this is TRUE
!(FALSE | TRUE) # this is FALSE
```

### AND: `&`
```{r}
TRUE & TRUE
TRUE & FALSE
FALSE & FALSE
```

### OR: `|`
```{r}
TRUE | TRUE
TRUE | FALSE
FALSE | FALSE
```

## Value Matching

`match()` returns the position of the first match of its first argument in
its second argument. Check `?match` for the full documentation.
```{r}
match("Species", c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", "Petal.Length",
                    "Petal.Width", "Species"))
```

`%in%` checks whether a value exists anywhere in a vector, returning
`TRUE`/`FALSE` instead of a position:
```{r}
"Species" %in% c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", "Petal.Length",
                  "Petal.Width", "Species")
```
